description: This file defines a set of API interaction functions for a frontend application to communicate with a backend service. It includes methods for making HTTP requests such as GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE, as well as specific functions for managing work items and their comments within a project management context.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or null. Throws on non-2xx responses.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error with message.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, ensures URL encoding, and handles JSON parsing.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON PATCH request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item via GET request.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null })
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a work item via POST request.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of work items, optionally filtered by projectId.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with provided properties.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item using PATCH request.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds a full URL for a given API path.

ctags.name: addWorkItemComment
ctags.pattern: /^export async function addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null }) {$/

ctags.name: createWorkItem
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priori/
ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })

ctags.name: updateWorkItemStatus
ctags.pattern: /^export async function updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status }) {$/
